references.text: The Lord swore that all the warriors over twenty years old would die in the wilderness because of their disobedience and lack of faith.
The Lord declared that the entire rebellious generation would perish in the wilderness, as fulfilled in Deuteronomy 2:16.
Confirmation that none of those counted at Sinai survived, except for Caleb and Joshua, who were exceptions to the judgment.
The context explaining that it took 38 years before all the warriors died, and that the Lord's hand was against them.
Joshua confirms that all the warriors who left Egypt died in the wilderness, and that a new generation would now take possession of the land.
Hebrews refers to that generation which sinned and whose bodies fell in the wilderness because of unbelief.
